## Prior art
`e2e/footer.spec.ts` covers the footer links on every public route but not that the Terms link is fully visible on a phone. At 390px the cookie bar covers it (this issue).

`e2e/footer.spec.ts`

1. Add the test.
2. Mark the 390 project `test.fail()` citing 0509#9004.

`npm run e2e -- e2e/footer.spec.ts`

One run, 20 minutes.

`app/lib/data/alert.server.ts` `insertDeliveryFailedAlert` returns nothing; `workers/delivery/dlq-consumer.ts` cannot tell a new alert from a repeat.

`app/lib/data/alert.server.ts`

## Build steps

2. Callers are unchanged in this packet.

`npm run lint`

One run, 20 minutes.
